{{Quote|Predor Tul'kar&hellip; will you obey the command?''"<br />"''Of course. As I am your Predor, Skal'nas is mine. Commands must be obeyed.|A Rakatan and Predor Tul'kar|<ref name="DotJ:FS1" />}}
'''Predor''' was the title of a [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] overlord.<ref name="DOTJ 0" /> [[Skal'nas]] and [[Tul'kar]] were Predors in the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]]. However, one Predor could be overlord to another Predor, as Skal'nas was superior in rank to Tul'kar. Despite this, Skal'nas could not commandeer Tul'kar's [[Force Hound]] without meeting him in combat.<ref name="DotJ:FS1" />

The [[Over-Predor]] ruled the Infinite Empire.<ref name="DOTJ 11">[[Dawn of the Jedi: Force War 1|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force War'' 1]]</ref>
